items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: in the trumpet section Burt Collins, Ziggy Harrel, Hal Espinosa, and Bill Berry

ctx.x: It said, “In the summer of 1960 many guys passed through the band, it mentions a lot of names, and in the trumpet section Burt Collins, Ziggy Harrel, Hal Espinosa, and Bill Berry. The turnover was very high, probably because the bread was low.
